source_text: Bazett's work measured densities (e.g., ~115 free nerve endings per cm²) in small samples but did not provide a total count for the entire foreskin; extrapolations to 10,000–20,000 relied on assumptions about surface area that lack standardization and have been critiqued as overestimations by an order of magnitude.
